references.text: Refers to the power of faith and God's ability to accomplish what seems impossible for humans.
Jesus speaks again about the power of faith to move mountains, and how prayer offered in faith will be answered.
Similar to Jesus' teaching in Matthew on the power of faith to move mountains and that whatever is asked for in faith will be received.
Emphasizes the necessity of faith to please God, and that anyone who approaches God must believe that He exists and rewards those who seek Him.
